verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents generally available sharding that scales a single namespace up to 256TB. Its object-storage architecture is described as scaling low-latency queries to petabyte scale, and single-tenant and BYOC deployments are offered alongside the multi-tenant default. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how sharding is configured or operated (shard count, rebalancing, node topology), detail on distributed BYOC or single-tenant operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-node scaling.
